text:
emma.r (marketing): hey @mike.l @tara.z — small but urgent ask for the launch blog + webinar. Can eng/runtime validate the bench numbers we're quoting and produce reproducible artifacts? Need this by EOD+2 days.

mike.l (eng/runtime): sure. what models/payloads and what counts as validation for you?

emma.r (marketing): Models: redwood-7b-v2 and redwood-13b-v1. For each: fp16 and q5_0 quant variants. Payload buckets: tiny (5 tokens), medium (64 tokens), long (384 tokens). Metrics: p50, p95, p99 latencies, tokens/sec, and estimate of $/1M tokens for hosted vs dedicated. Include sample size and seed.

tara.z (eng/runtime): do you want cold-start numbers too or only warm steady-state? Also, what concurrency/batch patterns should we show?

oliver.b (marketing): Warm steady-state is the headline. Add cold-start (first request after idle) as secondary. For concurrency: single-request latency, and throughput runs at batch sizes 4 and 32.

mike.l (eng/runtime): plan: smoke (quick) + full (N=300 per bucket). we'll run single, batch4, batch32. use seed 2026-04-01. We'll enable KV cache and attention opt for warm runs. Will log exact CLI, env vars, and docker image.

emma.r (marketing): We've uploaded canonical prompts: s3://redwood-marketing/launch/inputs/2026-04-01/payloads.jsonl.gz. Use that exact file. Please include a one-slide PNG (3 grouped bars per model: p50/p95/tokens/sec) and raw CSV. Also add a short methodology.md in root of artifact.

runtime-bot: bench-job-1782705555-smoke scheduled.

tara.z (eng/runtime): smoke passed. note: q5_0 had a different tokenizer rounding behavior on very short prompts; patched in bench harness and documented. full runs queued; ETA ~4.5h.

mike.l (eng/runtime): heads up: on long(384) p99 for q5_0 is ~22% higher than fp16 in this input set due to KV fragmentation; will mention tradeoffs in notes.

emma.r (marketing): ok — can you also capture GPU-util and a small span flamechart for a representative long request? design wants it for an appendix.

tara.z (eng/runtime): will capture GPU metrics and a perf profile. uploading artifacts to s3://redwood-marketing/launch/2026-04-01/artifacts/bench-job-1782705555/.

mike.l (eng/runtime): upload complete. artifacts: s3://redwood-marketing/launch/2026-04-01/artifacts/bench-job-1782705555/ contains raw-results.csv, summary-slide.png, methodology.md, perf-profile.svg, notes.txt. notes.txt documents tokenizer patch, seed=2026-04-01, and exact commands.

emma.r (marketing): perfect — we'll use fp16 for the headline figures and call out q5_0 as a lower-cost option with tail latency caveat. thanks so much.

oliver.b (marketing): if we need a region-specific rerun (ap-southeast), we might ask after launch. thanks team :tada:

mike.l (eng/runtime): happy to run region check later. ping if you need another iteration.
